milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because spruce trapdoors always drop themselves as an item when mined (with any tool or bare hands), so the mined block will appear in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 spruce_trapdoors, and there is exactly 1 in the scene, making this check unambiguous and spawn-position-independent. Preferred over count_in_box_at_most(kind=block) because inventory_has doesn't require tracking exact world coordinates of the placed block.
